content:
The latest stable release v4.2.0 for Lean is out now!

It includes a substantial performance improvement via improved caching, lake speed ups, and a number of bug fixes.

We encourage all users on previous stable releases v4.0.0 and v4.1.0 to try it out, and to update their repositories to use it.

Downstream users of Std, Aesop, or Mathlib who would like to stay on stable releases may use the v4.2.0 tags available in those repositories, or follow the stable branch.

(It also includes a stricter Environment API making environment hacking more obvious. To be clear, you can still create bad environments through metaprogramming if you really want to, but you have to jump through more hoops now to do so! These bad environments are still rejected by lean4checker, of course.)
